questions.question: In the NFL tracking data pipeline described in PART1_DETAIL.md, why does the constant-acceleration baseline fail on turns?
questions.answer: Because acceleration is treated as along-track (projected onto the current heading), which is exact for straight-line motion but wrong when a player cuts.
